jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.

This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Jobomschrijving

Application & Service Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
• Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
• Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
• Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
• Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
• Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.

IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

• Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.
• Monitor the quality and availability of workplace technologies, including hardware, networking, and telephony services.
• Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
• Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
• Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.

Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.

IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
• Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
• Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
• Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.
• Serve as a point of contact for audits and compliance-related activities.
• Support Business Continuity initiatives through planning, testing, and safeguarding critical business processes.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 5 years of experience in an IT-related role.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate and drive initiatives forward.
• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
• Able to connect people, facilitate collaboration, and navigate across different levels of an organization.
• Strong organizational and administrative skills with great attention to detail.
• Quality-driven with a focus on service continuity and operational excellence.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a strong advantage.

We are looking for a Functional IAM Business Analyst to join an Identity Governance (IGA) team at one of our clients in the financial sector. This isn't a generic BA role. You'll work at the heart of access governance, shaping how people get, keep and lose access across the organisation.
Your role

You'll define and improve the processes that govern who gets access to what. That includes access request flows, periodic recertification campaigns and Joiner-Mover-Leaver (JML) processes. You'll make sure these controls are robust enough for internal audit and regulators. You'll also follow up on control findings and translate them into concrete process improvements.
Making access simpler

Your "customers" are internal users: a manager reviewing 200 access rights, or an employee requesting the access they need to do their job. Your goal is to make those journeys simpler and less painful, without compromising compliance.

• Several years of experience as a Business Analyst in IAM or IT security

• Experience in banking or insurance is a strong advantage

• Hands-on functional experience with an IGA tool. SailPoint IdentityIQ is a big plus; Saviynt or Oracle Identity Manager are also relevant

• Solid knowledge of access reviews and certifications, RBAC and role models, Segregation of Duties (SOD) and least privilege

• Familiarity with banking regulation and control expectations (DORA, ECB/NBB, internal audit findings)

• At ease working with business stakeholders, audit and compliance teams

• Fluent in French or Dutch, plus English

A hands-on Network Architect role where Juniper and Fortinet meet complex, business-critical infrastructure.

Our partner is aninternational technology organisationoperating critical digital infrastructure. As part of the continued development of their infrastructure environment, they are looking for aNetwork Architectto join a highly skilled and collaborative technical team.

 

This is not a purely conceptual architecture role. You will move betweenarchitecture, design, implementation and production support, working with modern networking technologies and having a direct impact on the resilience and evolution of the infrastructure.

 

Your playground? Juniper, Fortinet, BGP, DNS, security and distributed infrastructure.
Network Architect - The Role
• Design and evolvenetwork architecturesacross complex and distributed production environments, from high-level concepts to low-level technical designs.
• Work hands-on withJuniper networking and Fortinet security technologies, including routing, switching, firewalls and network segmentation.
• Contribute toBGP, DNS/DNSSEC, high-availability and distributed infrastructure, with a strong focus on resilience and security.
• Drive improvements aroundautomation, monitoring and observability, using technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Python, Prometheus or Grafana.
• Collaborate withInfrastructure, Security, Architecture and Software Engineeringteams, while challenging and validating technical solutions delivered by external partners.
• Maintainarchitecture documentation, diagrams and technical standards, while supporting troubleshooting, lifecycle management and production environments.
Network Architect - The Profile
• 7+ years of experiencein network, infrastructure or systems engineering, with strong exposure to critical production environments.
• Strong expertise innetworking, including TCP/IP, routing, switching and protocols such as BGP and OSPF.
• Solid hands-on experience withJuniper and Fortinet— this is a key part of the role.
• Good understanding ofLinux, DNS/DNSSEC, firewalls and high-availability/distributed infrastructure.
• Exposure tovirtualisation, containers, private cloud or Infrastructure as Code(VMware, Kubernetes, Docker, Ansible, Terraform, etc.) is a strong plus.
• Analytical, pragmatic and hands-on mindset, with the ability to move from architecture and design to implementation and production troubleshooting. Fluent English is required.

jobs.occupation: Experienced Wheel Loader Operator Wanted for Recycling Site in Sint-Katelijne-Waver
jobs.description:

On an average day, you operate the wheel loader to move, sort, and stockpile rubble and recycled aggregates. You supply the crushing installation and assist with loading and unloading trucks. Operating a forklift is also part of your tasks, as well as carrying out daily inspections and basic maintenance of the machines. You promptly report technical issues and ensure the workplace remains safe and tidy, even in dusty conditions.

Does this hands-on, varied position appeal to you? Apply soon – I am happy to tell you more about this great opportunity.

• Valid wheel loader license (required by Belgian regulations)

• At least 1 to 2 years of relevant experience as a wheel loader operator

• Willingness to operate a forklift (license is a plus)

• Good command of English (spoken and written)

• Able to work independently and reliably

• Hands-on mentality and flexible

• Punctual, communicative, and in good physical condition

• Willing to work in a dusty, outdoor industrial environment

jobs.occupation: Become a Truck Mechanic – Put Your Technical Skills to Work for the Future!
jobs.description:
As a truck mechanic, you’ll be responsible for performing accurate diagnostics and repairs on trucks, with a strong focus on DAF vehicles. You see electrical malfunctions as challenges, read wiring diagrams with ease, and work according to the latest technical guidelines. You communicate clearly with customers and manufacturers about your work and support our branch in Herent when needed.

Your day starts in a fully equipped workshop where you collaborate with a young, dynamic team. You begin by planning the necessary repairs, running diagnostics with advanced equipment, and ensuring every truck is safe and ready for the road. You coordinate colleagues and provide technical support, helping the whole team deliver top results.

Ready to take the next step in your career as a mechanic? Apply today and let our enthusiastic team guide you as you grow and thrive!

• You have a technical diploma (A3/A2) in automotive mechanics or equivalent experience

• A bachelor’s degree in automotive technology is a plus

• At least 2 years of relevant experience in the automotive sector

• You have basic knowledge of electronics and experience with wiring diagrams

• You can work independently and take responsibility

• Experience in leading a team is an advantage

• Good command of English is required

• A C(E) driver’s license is an asset but not required

Our client specializes in bodywork and mechanical repairs for all car brands.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is looking for a skilled tinsmith to join their team. You will be responsible for the repair, maintenance, and installation of metal components. As a tinsmith you will play a key role in restoring and repairing vehicles or metal structures.

 

Your Responsibilities:
	
• Performing sheet metal work, including repairing damaged parts.	
• Installing and removing body panels, metal coverings, or structural components.	
• Metal processing (bending, straightening, cutting, welding).	
• Preparing surfaces for painting or further treatment.	
• Following safety regulations and maintaining a clean workspace.

Candidate Profile:
	
• Minimum 2 years of experience as a tinsmith.	
• Proficiency in using sheet metal tools (hammers, welding machines, grinders, etc.).	
• Knowledge of materials and techniques used in sheet metal work.	
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.	
• Attention to detail and precision in executing tasks.	
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch.

YOUR JOB IN A NUTSHELL

You’ll be the guardian of data quality making sure the information we rely on is accurate, reliable, and ready to power everything from seamless customer experiences to cutting-edge digital solutions. Think of it as being the detective, the problem-solver, and the strategist all in one, working with teams across the bank to keep our data in top shape.

 

AND IN DETAIL

As a Client Data Quality Analyst, here’s what your day could look like:

• Spot the gaps, fix the flaws. You’ll design and monitor data quality controls, using dashboards to track how well our systems are performing. 
• Turn data into a strategic advantage. You won’t just be fixing problems, you’ll be helping us use data smarter. That could mean:
• Upgrading dashboards so they give clearer, more actionable insights.
• Documenting metadata so everyone understands what our data means and how to use it.
• Supporting data certification and joining key committees to ensure we’re meeting the highest standards.
• Sharing your know-how with the wider Data Quality team, so we all keep getting better.
• Be the bridge between data and real-world impact You’ll get to know our client data flows and applications inside out, becoming the go-to person. Your work will directly help us improve customer experiences, streamline processes, and stay ahead in a fast-changing industry.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

We’re looking for someone who:

•  Loves solving puzzles. You see data as more than numbers; it’s a story waiting to be uncovered. Experience in data quality analysis (especially in banking) is a big plus.
• Speaks “data” fluently. You understand data lifecycles, governance, and how data drives decisions. You’ve done analysis that shows real business impact and you’re passionate about digital transformation.
• Is tech-savvy (but not a coding genius). You’re comfortable with tools like Excel, MS Access, PowerPoint, and Business Objects. If you’ve worked with Collibra, Ab Initio, Tableau, SQL, or Python, even better, but what matters most is your curiosity and willingness to learn.
• Communicates clearly and collaborates easily. You can explain complex ideas in simple terms (in French, Dutch, or English). You’re a team player who enjoys sharing knowledge and learning from others.
• Thrives on challenges. You don’t shy away from tricky problems. Instead, you roll up your sleeves, ask the right questions, and push for solutions that actually work.
